paragraph: Oradell is a single-family market, plain and simple. Thirty-one detached homes sold over six months at a median of $999,000, with a sale-to-list ratio of 1.11 and a median of 12 days on market. More than 93 percent of those homes sold above asking. That is a real seller's market, and multiple offer situations are the norm rather than the exception here. The range ran from $740,000 to $1,665,000, so the median is your better guide than either end. Only two condo or townhouse sales closed in the whole window, which is not enough to read as a tier. On the monthly numbers, volume built through spring and peaked at 12 closings in June, then July came in at 8 sales with a median of $930,500. That tracks the usual Bergen County seasonal arc, and if the pattern holds, expect closings and medians to ease through fall. If you're buying here, plan on moving fast and coming in strong. Homes are not sitting.
